SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS RNUM, A.* FROM ( SELECT S.STL_NO, S.SELLER_ID, L.SELLER_NM, S.ORD_NO, S.ITEM_SEQ, S.PRD_CD, S.SALE_AMT, S.COMM_RATE, S.COMM_AMT, S.STL_AMT, S.STL_STAT, (SELECT CD_NM FROM TB_CMM_CODE WHERE GRP_CD = 'STL_STAT' AND CD = S.STL_STAT) AS STL_STAT_NM, TO_CHAR(S.BASE_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS BASE_DT, TO_CHAR(S.CNFM_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS CNFM_DT, DECODE(S.CNFM_TYPE, 'B', '배치', 'M', '수동', '') AS CNFM_TYPE_NM, S.CNFM_RSN, S.PAY_SCHD_DT, TO_CHAR(S.PAY_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS PAY_DT, S.HOLD_RSN, TO_CHAR(S.HOLD_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS HOLD_DT, L.SELLER_STAT FROM TB_STL S JOIN TB_SELLER L ON L.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID
ORDER BY S.BASE_DT DESC, S.STL_NO DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{PAGE_NO} * #{PAGE_SIZE} ) WHERE RNUM > (#{PAGE_NO} - 1) * #{PAGE_SIZE}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_STL S JOIN TB_SELLER L ON L.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOT_CNT, NVL(SUM(X.SALE_AMT), 0) AS TOT_SALE_AMT, NVL(SUM(X.COMM_AMT), 0) AS TOT_COMM_AMT, NVL(SUM(X.STL_AMT), 0) AS TOT_STL_AMT, NVL(SUM(DECODE(X.STL_STAT, 'RDY', X.STL_AMT, 0)), 0) AS RDY_AMT, NVL(SUM(DECODE(X.STL_STAT, 'CNF', X.STL_AMT, 0)), 0) AS CNF_AMT, NVL(SUM(DECODE(X.STL_STAT, 'PAID', X.STL_AMT, 0)), 0) AS PAID_AMT, NVL(SUM(DECODE(X.STL_STAT, 'HOLD', X.STL_AMT, 0)), 0) AS HOLD_AMT FROM ( SELECT S.SALE_AMT, S.COMM_AMT, S.STL_AMT, S.STL_STAT FROM TB_STL S JOIN TB_SELLER L ON L.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID
) X WHERE X.STL_STAT <> 'CNCL'

SELECT STL_NO, SELLER_ID, ORD_NO, ITEM_SEQ, SALE_AMT, COMM_RATE, COMM_AMT, STL_AMT, STL_STAT, TO_CHAR(BASE_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS BASE_DT, TO_CHAR(CNFM_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS CNFM_DT, PAY_SCHD_DT, HOLD_RSN FROM TB_STL WHERE STL_NO = #{stlNo}

SELECT S.STL_NO, S.ORD_NO, S.ITEM_SEQ, S.PRD_CD, S.SALE_AMT, S.COMM_RATE, S.COMM_AMT, S.STL_AMT, S.STL_STAT, TO_CHAR(S.BASE_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS BASE_DT, TO_CHAR(S.CNFM_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS CNFM_DT, TO_CHAR(S.PAY_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS PAY_DT, S.HOLD_RSN FROM TB_STL S WHERE S.SELLER_ID = #{SELLER_ID} AND S.PAY_SCHD_DT = #{PAY_SCHD_DT} ORDER BY S.ORD_NO, S.ITEM_SEQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_STL ( STL_NO, SELLER_ID, ORD_NO, ITEM_SEQ, PRD_CD, SALE_AMT, COMM_RATE, COMM_AMT, STL_AMT, STL_STAT, BASE_DT, REG_DT, REG_ID) VALUES ( #{STL_NO}, #{SELLER_ID}, #{ORD_NO}, #{ITEM_SEQ}, #{PRD_CD}, #{SALE_AMT}, #{COMM_RATE}, #{COMM_AMT}, #{STL_AMT}, 'RDY', TRUNC(SYSDATE), SYSDATE, #{REG_ID})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_STL SET STL_STAT = 'CNCL', CNCL_DT = SYSDATE, UPD_DT = SYSDATE, UPD_ID = #{UPD_ID} WHERE STL_NO = #{STL_NO} AND STL_STAT = 'RDY'
UPDATE TB_STL SET STL_STAT = 'HOLD', HOLD_RSN = #{HOLD_RSN}, HOLD_DT = SYSDATE, HOLD_ID = #{UPD_ID}, UPD_DT = SYSDATE, UPD_ID = #{UPD_ID} WHERE STL_NO = #{STL_NO} AND STL_STAT IN ('RDY', 'CNF')

UPDATE TB_STL SET STL_STAT = DECODE(CNFM_DT, NULL, 'RDY', 'CNF'), PAY_SCHD_DT = DECODE(CNFM_DT, NULL, PAY_SCHD_DT, #{PAY_SCHD_DT}), UPD_DT = SYSDATE, UPD_ID = #{UPD_ID} WHERE STL_NO = #{STL_NO} AND STL_STAT = 'HOLD'

UPDATE TB_STL SET STL_STAT = 'CNF', CNFM_DT = SYSDATE, CNFM_TYPE = 'M', CNFM_RSN = #{CNFM_RSN}, PAY_SCHD_DT = #{PAY_SCHD_DT}, UPD_DT = SYSDATE, UPD_ID = #{UPD_ID} WHERE STL_NO = #{STL_NO} AND STL_STAT = 'RDY'

MERGE INTO TB_STL_PAY T USING ( SELECT #{SELLER_ID} AS SELLER_ID, #{PAY_SCHD_DT} AS PAY_SCHD_DT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_STL WHERE SELLER_ID = #{SELLER_ID} AND PAY_SCHD_DT = #{PAY_SCHD_DT} AND STL_STAT = 'CNF') AS STL_CNT, (SELECT NVL(SUM(STL_AMT), 0) FROM TB_STL WHERE SELLER_ID = #{SELLER_ID} AND PAY_SCHD_DT = #{PAY_SCHD_DT} AND STL_STAT = 'CNF') AS PAY_AMT FROM DUAL ) A ON (T.SELLER_ID = A.SELLER_ID AND T.PAY_SCHD_DT = A.PAY_SCHD_DT) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.STL_CNT = A.STL_CNT, T.PAY_AMT = A.PAY_AMT, T.PAY_STAT = DECODE(A.STL_CNT, 0, 'H', 'W'), T.UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE T.PAY_STAT IN ('W', 'H') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (STL_PAY_NO, SELLER_ID, PAY_SCHD_DT, STL_CNT, PAY_AMT, PAY_STAT, BANK_CD, STL_ACCT_NO, REG_DT) VALUES ('SPY' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || LPAD(SQ_STL_PAY.NEXTVAL, 6, '0'), A.SELLER_ID, A.PAY_SCHD_DT, A.STL_CNT, A.PAY_AMT, 'W', (SELECT BANK_CD FROM TB_SELLER WHERE SELLER_ID = A.SELLER_ID), (SELECT STL_ACCT_NO FROM TB_SELLER WHERE SELLER_ID = A.SELLER_ID), SYSDATE)

UPDATE TB_STL S SET S.STL_STAT = 'HOLD', S.HOLD_RSN = '판매자 정지', S.HOLD_DT = SYSDATE, S.HOLD_ID = 'BATCH', S.UPD_DT = SYSDATE, S.UPD_ID = 'BATCH' WHERE S.STL_STAT = 'CNF' AND S.PAY_SCHD_DT <= #{PAY_YMD} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SELLER L WHERE L.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID AND L.SELLER_STAT IN #{stat})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT P.SELLER_ID, P.PAY_SCHD_DT FROM TB_STL_PAY P WHERE P.PAY_SCHD_DT <= #{PAY_YMD} AND P.PAY_STAT IN ('W', 'H')
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_STL SET STL_STAT = 'PAID', PAY_DT = SYSDATE, UPD_DT = SYSDATE, UPD_ID = 'BATCH' WHERE STL_STAT = 'CNF' AND PAY_SCHD_DT <= #{PAY_YMD}
UPDATE TB_STL_PAY SET PAY_STAT = 'P', PAY_DT = SYSDATE, UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE PAY_STAT = 'W' AND PAY_SCHD_DT <= #{PAY_YMD} AND PAY_AMT > 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CMM_HOLIDAY WHERE HOLI_YMD = #{ymd}
